title: Unit Event — Dear Me, From Back Then — Episode4 HONEY In Tokyo

meta.Event Outline: The time has finally arrived for the first solo show of MORE MORE JUMP! Minori still can't seem to shake her nerves, but is reminded of the time she saw an ASRUN show for the first time after Haruka tells Minori a story about her own past...

rows.Speaker: Member of ASRUN
rows.Line: Thank you all for coming to see us today!

rows.Speaker: Member of ASRUN
rows.Line: ASRUN's Tour of Japan: “HONEY” in Tokyo is just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Some of you out there may be going through some sad or tough times and have a lot on your minds right now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we want you to forget about all of that today! Let's make the most of our time together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I... I knew it...
Haruka really is the best...!)

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
Oh, it's this song...
The one from your DVD...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We practiced it a lot together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka just gave me some words of encouragement, so it's time for me to do the same for her!

rows.Speaker: Member of ASRUN
rows.Line:
Hm...?
I can't hear you! Is that all you got?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You guys can do better than that, right?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice!
That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now, it's time for us to respond!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's like our cheering and Haruka's singing are coming together as one song.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Practicing this at home was fun, but this is something else...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Everyone! Can you hear me?!
Let's keep having more fun together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Haruka really is incredible.
I can't take my eyes off her. She's sparkling even more compared to when I see her on TV...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (All that doubt I felt just a second ago... It's all gone!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(The way she smiles and sings...
It fills me with so much joy and energy.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wanna keep singing with her...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm gonna do everything I can to make her singing, dancing and overall performance even more exciting... And then...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I'm gonna show her how I feel...
I'm gonna show just how much I admire her!)

rows.Speaker: Member of ASRUN
rows.Line: Thanks for keeping up with us until now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Unfortunately, our next song is going to be our last one for today...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As sad as it is to say goodbye to one another, we promise to cap off this amazing day with an unforgettable performance! Are you all ready?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm ready, Haruka!
I promise to cheer my lungs out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, here comes the song you've all been waiting for...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
All the glow sticks just turned orange...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But this is their first time performing this song... How did they all know what to do...? Also...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line:
Noooo!!
ASRUN, I'm not ready to go home yet!!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line:
I'll keep rooting for you!!
I promise to go to your shows in Fukuoka and Sendai!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your kind thoughts!
Let's make this song a moment to remember!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This song... It's like everyone's a part of it... Not just Haruka and the others. The entire audience as well...)

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: Before, I honestly didn't fully comprehend what you liking idols and being a fan of a specific one meant...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: I sort of brushed off what you've been saying until now. But after seeing them for myself...

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line: I understand why you love ASRUN and Haruka Kiritani so much... Because... Because...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Even though she said she felt really embarrassed when we were practicing at my house...)

rows.Speaker: Member of ASRUN
rows.Line:
Is that all you got?!
I know you can do better than that!

rows.Speaker: Member of ASRUN
rows.Line:
How are you guys doing?!
Tell us! Show us how you really feel!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line:
I'll follow you wherever!
I'm your fan forever!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We heard you loud and clear!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Now I see...
This place, this atmosphere... It was all designed to bring us and the idols together.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The way we cheered for ASRUN, and the way they responded to us...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Some of you out there may be going through some sad or tough times and have a lot on your minds right now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we want you to forget about all of that today! Let's make the most of our time together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's like everyone here is becoming one... And they're making it all happen.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They understand my worries and concerns, and are cheering me on to keep going.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I feel this bond forming between us...
It feels like they're rooting for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's why we're all this excited...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And standing at the center of all that...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The heart of this venue and atmosphere is...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's all sweaty after doing so many laps around the stage... But she's still sparkling...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She keeps smiling while responding to our calls, while singing and dancing with everything she has.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(The way she smiles and sings...
It fills me with so much joy and energy.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is what it means to be a real idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It was ASRUN's agency too, so I was really hoping that I'd get in. I even made sure to write, “I want to become a super idol who's an amazing singer and dancer, like Haruka!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I already figured out how to do the dance for this song! I think I can do it on demand now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Does this mean I have real talent...?
Do I have what it takes to become an idol?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Just because I learned to dance a little, that doesn't mean I'm ready to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Copying them is one thing, but this is completely different...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've decided that I'm gonna become an idol just like Haruka, so I need to be more optimistic!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It just isn't that easy, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right now, there's probably no way that I can become an amazing idol like Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I want to be up there...
I want to stand on that stage.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka encouraged me, so I wanna find a way to do that for someone else.

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
It's Haruka!
She's coming towards us on a little trolley!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's make the best of our time together and make this a moment to remember.

rows.Speaker: Chihiro
rows.Line:
Th-That was so awesome...!
She was right there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I wanna sing with her...
While standing next to her...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I wanna sing and spread hope to lots and lots of people...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just wait, Haruka!!
I'll be up there with you soon...!!
